# sharepoint_list_view (Resource)

Creates a view on a SharePoint list using the M365 CLI (m365 spo list view add / get / set / remove). Everything set at creation is immutable in place; use the properties map to update individual view properties (e.g. Title, JSLink, CustomFormatter) afterwards, matching what `m365 spo list view set` accepts as named options.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sharepoint_list_view" "open_requests" {
  web_url    = sharepoint_list.requests.web_url
  list_title = sharepoint_list.requests.title
  title      = "Open requests"
  fields     = ["LinkTitle", "RequestStatus", "Author", "Created"]
  row_limit  = 50
  view_query = "<Where><Eq><FieldRef Name=\"RequestStatus\" /><Value Type=\"Choice\">New</Value></Eq></Where><OrderBy><FieldRef Name=\"Created\" Ascending=\"FALSE\" /></OrderBy>"

  depends_on = [sharepoint_field.request_status]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) Title of the view. To rename an existing view, set Title in properties instead of changing this attribute (it identifies the view at creation only).
- `web_url` (String) URL of the site where the list is located.

### Optional

- `calendar_default_layout` (String) Default layout of a calendar view: month, week, workWeek, or day.
- `calendar_end_date_field` (String) Internal name of the field with the calendar event's end date. Required when type is calendar.
- `calendar_start_date_field` (String) Internal name of the field with the calendar event's start date. Required when type is calendar.
- `calendar_sub_title_field` (String) Internal name of the field with the calendar event's subtitle.
- `calendar_title_field` (String) Internal name of the field with the calendar event's title. Required when type is calendar.
- `default` (Boolean) Set this view as the list's default view.
- `fields` (List of String) Ordered, case-sensitive internal names of the fields to show in the view. Optional when type is calendar.
- `kanban_bucket_field` (String) Internal name of the field used as the Kanban board's bucket. Required when type is kanban.
- `list_id` (String) ID of the list. Specify exactly one of list_title, list_id, list_url.
- `list_title` (String) Title of the list. Specify exactly one of list_title, list_id, list_url.
- `list_url` (String) Relative URL of the list. Specify exactly one of list_title, list_id, list_url.
- `paged` (Boolean) Whether the view supports paging.
- `personal` (Boolean) Create the view as a personal view.
- `properties` (Map of String) View property overrides applied via `m365 spo list view set` after creation, keyed by REST property name (e.g. Title, JSLink, CustomFormatter). Removing a key from this map stops Terraform from tracking it but does not revert it remotely.
- `row_limit` (Number) Number of items to display per page.
- `type` (String) Type of the view: list, calendar, gallery, or kanban.
- `view_query` (String) CAML query XML (filter/sort) for the view.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) GUID assigned to the view by SharePoint.
